name: dev1
description: Development and IaC agent — GitLab, GitHub docs, Context7, Terraform (registry + operator), Graphistry. Use for code repos, live SDK docs, infrastructure as code, and dependency graph visualization.

gitlab.description: GitLab MCP (Alithya CSNA) — projects, issues, merge requests, pipelines. Use when user asks about GitLab repositories, MRs, CI/CD pipelines, or Alithya project code.

context7.description: Live documentation lookup for any library, SDK, or framework. Use this to verify up-to-date API signatures, import paths, constructor conventions, and code examples before writing code. Fetches real-time docs from the source — never relies on training data.

terraform-mcp.description: HashiCorp official Terraform MCP Server. Searches Terraform Registry for providers, modules, and policies. Use when writing Terraform code to find correct module inputs/outputs, provider capabilities, and best-practice modules.

tfmcp.description: Terraform MCP operator — execute terraform init/plan/apply/destroy, generate dependency graphs (DOT format), analyze state/drift, manage workspaces. Chain with quickchart-mcp for visual rendering of graphs. Use when asked to operate Terraform or visualize resource dependencies.

graphistry-mcp.description: GPU-accelerated interactive graph visualization via Graphistry. Takes edge/node data and produces an interactive web visualization (zoom, pan, filter, search). Use for LARGE dependency graphs (70+ nodes) where static PNG is unreadable. Chain: tfmcp (graph data) → graphistry-mcp (interactive web view).
